candidate_practices.name: Specify the dependency being replaced
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts identify a restrictive dependency or analytical setting and describe the replacement that enables their proposed scope.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes novelty assessable as a concrete change rather than a priority assertion.
candidate_practices.application: Replace 'a novel framework' with a sentence naming the previous requirement, the new mechanism, and any replacement assumptions.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not imply a dependency has disappeared when it is merely relocated to preprocessing or training.

support.specific_example: IDOL targets instantaneous dependence without latent interventions or grouped observations, using sparse influence, variability, and context.
CLIP customization responds to BatchNorm-dependent distillation with image-text matching and prompt-based surrogate-data inversion.
DSPO responds to an estimated loss introduced by transferred preference techniques through score matching and preferred-distribution score distillation.
Neural-collapse analysis moves from unconstrained features to end-to-end networks with at least two terminal linear layers.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Whether replacements actually remove the stated dependencies, their additional restrictions, and the scope of prior work.

candidate_practices.name: Give components distinct jobs
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts attach named components to specific transformations or targeted failures.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can inspect why several contributions belong in one system without treating the component list as evidence of effectiveness.
candidate_practices.application: Rewrite a module inventory as component–operation–target clauses; distinguish intended roles from demonstrated effects.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Avoid artificial one-to-one assignments when components jointly address inseparable effects.

support.specific_example: OptionZero separates autonomous option discovery from dynamics modeling that permits option-based deeper search.
TimeMixer++ distinguishes time imaging, seasonal/trend decomposition, cross-scale aggregation, and cross-resolution integration.
CyberHost combines regional identity-related features and structural conditioning aimed at motion uncertainty.
TANGO uses AuMoClip for audio–motion retrieval alignment and ACInterp for transition generation and appearance consistency.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Whether component effects are separable, whether interactions matter, and which evaluations support the assigned roles.

candidate_practices.name: Measure the capability implicated by the gap
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts connect the proposed contribution to a specific evaluation object beyond undifferentiated overall performance.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: matching measurement to the motivating claim can expose success that a convenient proxy would miss.
candidate_practices.application: Name the target capability and the quantity or evaluation dimensions used to assess it; distinguish benchmark construction from model improvement.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not introduce a new metric or taxonomy solely to favor a method when existing measurements already capture the claim.

support.specific_example: Probabilistic evaluation targets output distributions after deterministic decoding reportedly signals false unlearning or alignment success.
PhysBench defines physical understanding through domains, subclasses, and capability dimensions, then reports a common-sense versus physical-understanding distinction.
Compositional Entailment Learning connects image–box–text hierarchy and entailment objectives to reported hierarchical performance alongside retrieval and zero-shot results.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Metric validity, taxonomy coverage, guarantee conditions, and whether measurements distinguish the claimed capability from confounds.

candidate_practices.name: Make the comparison's constraint visible
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts qualify comparisons through compute matching, input availability, or multiple competing objectives.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the comparison becomes useful for a concrete decision because its resource or objective boundary is visible.
candidate_practices.application: Attach the budget, input regime, or trade-off axes directly to the result sentence; retain any stated success regime.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not call comparisons matched when only one resource is controlled, or reduce a trade-off frontier to unconditional superiority.

support.specific_example: Test-time scaling reports efficiency versus best-of-N and a FLOPs-matched larger-model comparison where the smaller model already has non-trivial success.
ProtComposer reports designability–novelty–diversity frontiers and PDB-like helix fractions rather than only a single quality score.
UGround distinguishes grounding performance from agent results and notes that comparison agents retain additional text inputs.

contrasts.contrast: RMP-SAM claims an optimal accuracy–speed balance, but the extraction supplies neither operating points nor a real-time threshold; that wording alone does not make the comparison assessable.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Compute accounting, operating points, baseline configurations, input asymmetries, and metric aggregation.

candidate_practices.name: Expose the logical bridge behind an explanation
candidate_practices.source_observation: These theory-oriented abstracts identify an analytical object or intermediate property and connect it to stated consequences.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: naming the bridge lets readers distinguish an explanation from an outcome claim without requiring a proof in the abstract.
candidate_practices.application: Write the dependency chain using the actual analyzed setting, intermediate property, and consequence; label simulations separately from theoretical results.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not convert a proposed mechanism or empirical association into a theorem or causal conclusion.

support.specific_example: Convex duality connects an equivalent representation to stationary points, width-dependent topology, nonuniqueness, and architecture extensions.
Reward flatness is connected through action-perturbation robustness to transition and reward changes, with simulations addressing those variation types.
The FixMatch analysis contrasts discriminative-feature coverage with supervised learning's subset learning, then motivates SA-FixMatch.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Formal assumptions, definitions, proof validity, causal status, and whether extensions preserve the original result.

candidate_practices.name: Explain what synthetic data changes
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts characterize generation as a transformation of available experience or knowledge, with an accompanying explanatory account.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: specifying the transformation makes 'more synthetic data' a testable rationale rather than an explanation by volume alone.
candidate_practices.application: Name the generation unit, how it reorganizes or expands existing material, and the reported explanation for its learning effect.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: If only aggregate performance is established, present the transformation as method description and the explanation as a hypothesis.

support.specific_example: Prioritized Generative Replay densifies experience and guides generation toward relevant history, with reported diversity and overfitting analysis.
EntiGraph synthesizes text through entity connections and supplies a mathematical account of knowledge rearrangement for data-efficient learning.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Faithfulness, diversity measurement, generation costs, and whether the explanation accounts for measured improvements.

candidate_practices.name: Define breadth through tasks and input modes
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts make broad capability claims concrete by naming supported tasks or conditioning modes.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: an explicit capability boundary is more inspectable than adjectives such as universal or controllable.
candidate_practices.application: Replace a broad capability adjective with supported task or input–operation pairs, distinguishing demonstrated modes from proposed uses.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not enumerate nominal variants that have no meaningful behavioral difference or imply equal validation across modes.

support.specific_example: RMP-SAM defines multi-purpose segmentation as interactive, panoptic, and video instance segmentation in one end-to-end model.
ProtComposer maps manual, extracted, and statistically sampled ellipsoids to control, redesign, and generation.
Loopy emphasizes audio-driven motion without manually specified movement constraints.

contrasts.contrast: CyberHost uses structural priors and supports video and hybrid driving; removing conditioning is not a general goal across animation systems.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Exact input requirements, training versus inference distinctions, and separate evidence for each capability.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Separate a conditional guarantee from how training supplies its assumptions.
unusual_but_useful.application: State the generic implication first, then identify which training regime establishes each condition.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Width alone must not be presented as establishing conditions that additionally require near-optimality or stability.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Describe operation with and without inference-time source access.
unusual_but_useful.application: Separate knowledge use without documents from reported combination with retrieval.
unusual_but_useful.limit: The extraction neither quantifies compounding nor establishes replacement of retrieval.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Every abstract needs a deficiency-first method narrative.
discarded_generalizations.reason: The landscape abstract starts with analytical scope; ProtComposer starts with a representation and capabilities.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: A resource is only supporting material for an algorithm.
discarded_generalizations.reason: GUI-grounding data and PhysBench's capability taxonomy are explicit contributions.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Every theory assumption should become a module or loss.
discarded_generalizations.reason: IDOL operationalizes sparsity; variability and context are not thereby shown to be enforced computationally.

discarded_generalizations.reason: Selected abstracts provide neither selection evidence nor a framework comparison.
